notes.title: Update 1.1.0.6
notes.notes:
Starting now : 
- New rewards added in game when reporting a bug or when the devs feels generous,
- Localisation fix,
- In fight, the bottom stack showing sequence of cards is fixed (bad card kind / uses affects were disappearing),
- Arena mode : added an history button to show last league result.

In one or two days :

notes.title: Update 0.0.538
notes.notes:
This update contains the following items : 
- Published a new tutorial to learns the basics of character details / card details
- Fixed a bug where you could crash the game when middle-clicking an empty slot on the Team overlay,
- Fixed a bug where "New" items state on codex where resetted when playing Arena.

notes.title: Update 0.0.537
notes.notes:
Modifications:
- End of the game : Adding a card in a chest will increase the cost of the next one by +50% of the initial costs (from +100%). Exemple for a T3: first stash costs 20 gold, second is 30, third is 40 (was 20/40/60).
- PVP vs PVE : prices for stashing card at the end of the game has been updated according to the game mode. 

Bugs fixes:
- Some missing Translations,
- Having troubles accessing Steam Lobby API no longer prevents you from starting a game,
- The Jeweller didn't properly updated buttons when adding a spell in some specific cases,
- Arena Mod : fix for steam avatars not properly displayed.

notes.title: Update 0.0.449
notes.notes:
[h1]GOC Royale - 0.0.449 release note[/h1]

Greetings, dear adventurer!

This update contains a bunch of additions that complete the entire game cycle:
- The [b]Meet phases[/b] are available. You will be able to meet 36 unique characters and their henchmen. They all have various possible interactions, as well as secret choices that only kick in when certain conditions are met. Will you manage to discover all these secrets? Or would you rather try to kill them and strip them of their equipment? 

-The [b]Trap phases[/b] are available with their innovative concept. For each trap, you can try to get out of it in 3 different ways. Choose the right statistic, roll a die and cross your fingers to avoid the catastrophic effects of these traps...

A big cosmetic update has been made:
- From now on, each race/class has a [b]unique appearance[/b]! That's 56 unique characters to play with, with over 7000 audio phrases generated! This affects the size of the game, but the experience is even more immersive. We hope you enjoy these changes!

Apart from these big changes, various optimizations have been made, the AI of the bots has been improved, many bugs have been fixed.

Finally, new equipment and spells have been added, bringing the [b]total number of cards in the game to ... 1337![/b] Could this be a geek game?


We are still in active development, but if you are intrigued, a preview version is available (without tutorial, but with our help!). [b]Gather your friends, contact us on our Discord [/b]and we'll be happy to let you try GOC Royale!

notes.title: v. 0.0.415 - release note
notes.notes:
[h2]New features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added end game phase including stashing cards and persisting user collection.
[*]Added global fight stats to end game.
[*]Added control of bots during the fight,
[*]Meet cards for blacksmith/jeweller/merchant now include non-player characters which have a race, a class and an inventory.
[*]Added steam logging to display steam username in game.
[*]Added language selection at home
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Most of attached spells now trigger only once per turn.
[*]Jeweller now helps you choose spells to attach on your items.
[*]Added dead players to fight rewards.
[*]Fight continues for team when only monsters remain.
[*]Added new toasts.
[*]Added ratio for fight card (ie. rats number is doubled).
[*]Updated stuff cooldown for monsters which were skipping actions.
[/list]

And various bugs fixing.

We hope you'll enjoy growing your own collection!
